changed.name: Acknowledge Receipt
changed.text_before: Providers SHOULD promptly and automatically acknowledge the receipt of messages received from FedRAMP in their FedRAMP Security Inbox.
changed.text_after: Providers SHOULD promptly and automatically acknowledge the receipt of messages received from FedRAMP in their FedRAMP Security Inbox.

changed.name: Complete Required Actions
changed.text_before: Providers MUST complete the required actions in Emergency or Emergency Test designated messages sent by FedRAMP within the timeframe included in the message.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST complete the required actions in Emergency or Emergency Test designated messages sent by FedRAMP within the timeframe included in the message.

changed.name: Emergency Message Routing
changed.text_before: Providers MUST route Emergency designated messages sent by FedRAMP to a senior security official for their awareness.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST route Emergency designated messages sent by FedRAMP to a senior security official for their awareness.

changed.name: Important Message Actions
changed.text_before: Providers SHOULD complete the required actions in Important designated messages sent by FedRAMP within the timeframe specified in the message.
changed.text_after: Providers SHOULD complete the required actions in Important designated messages sent by FedRAMP within the timeframe specified in the message.

changed.name: Maintain a FedRAMP Security Inbox
changed.text_before: Providers MUST establish and maintain an email address to receive messages from FedRAMP; this inbox is a FedRAMP Security Inbox (FSI).
changed.text_after: Providers MUST establish and maintain an email address to receive messages from FedRAMP; this inbox is a FedRAMP Security Inbox (FSI).

changed.name: Notification of Changes
changed.text_before: Providers MUST immediately notify FedRAMP of any changes to the email address for their FedRAMP Security Inbox.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST immediately notify FedRAMP of any changes to the email address for their FedRAMP Security Inbox.

changed.name: Receive Email Without Disruption
changed.text_before: Providers MUST receive and react to email messages from FedRAMP without disruption and without requiring additional actions from FedRAMP.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST receive and react to email messages from FedRAMP without disruption and without requiring additional actions from FedRAMP.

changed.name: Trust @fedramp.gov and @gsa.gov
changed.text_before: Providers MUST treat any email originating from an @fedramp.gov or @gsa.gov email address as if it was sent from FedRAMP by default; if such a message is confirmed to originate from someone other than FedRAMP then the FedRAMP Security Inbox rules no longer apply.

changed.text_before: FedRAMP MUST send messages to cloud service providers using an official @fedramp.gov or @gsa.gov email address with properly configured Sender Policy Framework (SPF), DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM), and Domain-based Message Authentication Reporting and Conformance (DMARC) email authentication.

changed.text_after: Agencies MUST maintain agency-wide policy that aligns with the requirements in OMB Memorandum M-24-15.

changed.text_after: Agencies SHOULD assign at least 1 federal employee to be an active participant in the FedRAMP Agency Liaison program.

changed.name: Notify FedRAMP After Authorization
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST notify FedRAMP upon authorizing the use of a cloud service within the scope of FedRAMP, supplying at least the following information:
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST notify FedRAMP upon authorizing the use of a cloud service within the scope of FedRAMP, supplying at least the following information:

changed.name: Notify Additional Information Requests
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST notify FedRAMP after requesting any additional information or materials from a FedRAMP Certified cloud service offering beyond those required by FedRAMP.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST notify FedRAMP after requesting any additional information or materials from a FedRAMP Certified cloud service offering beyond those required by FedRAMP.

changed.name: No Additional Security Requirements
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST NOT require additional information or materials from FedRAMP Certified cloud service offerings beyond those required by FedRAMP UNLESS the head of the agency or an authorized delegate determines there is a demonstrable need and notifies FedRAMP; this does not apply to seeking clarification or asking general questions about FedRAMP Certification Data.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST NOT require additional information or materials from FedRAMP Certified cloud service offerings beyond those required by FedRAMP UNLESS the head of the agency or an authorized delegate determines there is a demonstrable need and notifies FedRAMP; this does not apply to seeking clarification or asking general questions about FedRAMP Certification Data.

changed.name: Shared FedRAMP Inbox
changed.text_before: Agencies SHOULD establish and maintain a dedicated shared FedRAMP agency inbox to serve as the official point of contact for communications between FedRAMP and the agency.
changed.text_after: Agencies SHOULD establish and maintain a dedicated shared FedRAMP agency inbox to serve as the official point of contact for communications between FedRAMP and the agency.

changed.name: No Certification Type or Path Preferences
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST NOT require cloud service offerings to obtain or maintain a specific FedRAMP Certification Type or FedRAMP Certification Path, UNLESS the head of the agency or an authorized delegate determines there is a demonstrable need and notifies FedRAMP.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST NOT require cloud service offerings to obtain or maintain a specific FedRAMP Certification Type or FedRAMP Certification Path, UNLESS the head of the agency or an authorized delegate determines there is a demonstrable need and notifies FedRAMP.

changed.name: FedRAMP Working Groups
changed.text_before: Agencies SHOULD participate in FedRAMP working groups, communities of practice, and stakeholder engagements to supply feedback and align practices across government.
changed.text_after: Agencies SHOULD participate in FedRAMP working groups, communities of practice, and stakeholder engagements to supply feedback and align practices across government.

changed.name: Most Recent Consolidated Rules
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST follow the most recent FedRAMP Consolidated Rules when initiating agency-sponsored FedRAMP Certification.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST follow the most recent FedRAMP Consolidated Rules when initiating agency-sponsored FedRAMP Certification.

changed.name: Authorization Before Use
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST complete the Authorization to Operate process for federal information systems that use FedRAMP Certified cloud service offerings.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST complete the Authorization to Operate process for federal information systems that use FedRAMP Certified cloud service offerings.

changed.name: Accept FedRAMP Rules
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST allow FedRAMP Certified cloud service offerings to follow FedRAMP rules.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST allow FedRAMP Certified cloud service offerings to follow FedRAMP rules.

changed.name: Using FedRAMP Class A Certifications
changed.text_before: Agencies SHOULD NOT authorize the use of a FedRAMP Class A Certified cloud service offering for more than 12 months UNLESS the cloud service offering is actively seeking a FedRAMP Class B, C, or D Certification.
changed.text_after: Agencies SHOULD NOT authorize the use of a FedRAMP Class A Certified cloud service offering for more than 12 months UNLESS the cloud service offering is actively seeking a FedRAMP Class B, C, or D Certification.

changed.name: Designate Senior Official
changed.text_before: Agencies SHOULD designate a federal senior information security official to review Ongoing Certification Reports and represent the agency at Quarterly Reviews for cloud service offerings included in agency information systems.
changed.text_after: Agencies SHOULD designate a federal senior information security official to review Ongoing Certification Reports and represent the agency at Quarterly Reviews for cloud service offerings included in agency information systems.

changed.name: Notify FedRAMP of Monitoring Concerns
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST notify FedRAMP if information presented in an Ongoing Certification Report, Quarterly Review, or other FedRAMP Certification Data causes significant concerns for the authorizing official that would likely result in rescission of their Authorization to Operate.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST notify FedRAMP if information presented in an Ongoing Certification Report, Quarterly Review, or other FedRAMP Certification Data causes significant concerns for the authorizing official that would likely result in rescission of their Authorization to Operate.

changed.name: Notify Provider of Concerns
changed.text_before: Agencies SHOULD formally notify the cloud service provider if information presented in an Ongoing Certification Report, Quarterly Review, or other FedRAMP Certification Data causes significant concerns for the authorizing official that would likely result in rescission of their Authorization to Operate.
changed.text_after: Agencies SHOULD formally notify the cloud service provider if information presented in an Ongoing Certification Report, Quarterly Review, or other FedRAMP Certification Data causes significant concerns for the authorizing official that would likely result in rescission of their Authorization to Operate.

changed.name: Resolve Certification Package Conflicts
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST collaborate with FedRAMP when discrepancies or conflicts arise between agency-specific security determinations and the FedRAMP Certification Package.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST collaborate with FedRAMP when discrepancies or conflicts arise between agency-specific security determinations and the FedRAMP Certification Package.

changed.name: Review All Information Resources
changed.text_before: Agencies SHOULD consider third-party information resources used by the cloud service offering during initial and ongoing authorization activities.
changed.text_after: Agencies SHOULD consider third-party information resources used by the cloud service offering during initial and ongoing authorization activities.

changed.name: Review Ongoing Certification Reports
changed.text_before: Agencies SHOULD review each Ongoing Certification Report to understand how changes to the cloud service offering may impact the risk tolerance documented in the agency Authorization to Operate for the federal information system that includes the cloud service offering in its boundary.
changed.text_after: Agencies SHOULD review each Ongoing Certification Report to understand how changes to the cloud service offering may impact the risk tolerance documented in the agency Authorization to Operate for the federal information system that includes the cloud service offering in its boundary.

changed.name: Review Secure Configuration Guides
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST review the Secure Configuration Guides supplied by Providers and configure relevant security settings.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST review the Secure Configuration Guides supplied by Providers and configure relevant security settings.

changed.name: Consider Security Category
changed.text_before: Agencies SHOULD consider the Security Category noted in their Authorization to Operate of the federal information system that includes the cloud service offering in its boundary and assign appropriate information security resources for reviewing Ongoing Certification Reports, attending Quarterly Reviews, and other ongoing FedRAMP Certification Data.
changed.text_after: Agencies SHOULD consider the Security Category noted in their Authorization to Operate of the federal information system that includes the cloud service offering in its boundary and assign appropriate information security resources for reviewing Ongoing Certification Reports, attending Quarterly Reviews, and other ongoing FedRAMP Certification Data.

changed.name: Review Ongoing Reports
changed.text_before: Agencies MUST review each Ongoing Certification Report to understand how changes to the cloud service offering may impact the previously agreed-upon risk tolerance documented in the agency's Authorization to Operate of a federal information system that includes the cloud service offering in its boundary.
changed.text_after: Agencies MUST review each Ongoing Certification Report to understand how changes to the cloud service offering may impact the previously agreed-upon risk tolerance documented in the agency's Authorization to Operate of a federal information system that includes the cloud service offering in its boundary.

changed.name: Anonymized Feedback Summary
changed.text_before: Providers MUST supply an anonymized and desensitized summary of the feedback, questions, and answers about each Ongoing Certification Report as an addendum to the Ongoing Certification Report OR in the next Ongoing Certification Report.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST supply an anonymized and desensitized summary of the feedback, questions, and answers about each Ongoing Certification Report as an addendum to the Ongoing Certification Report OR in the next Ongoing Certification Report.

changed.text_before: Providers MUST NOT irresponsibly disclose sensitive information in an Ongoing Certification Report that would likely have an adverse effect on the cloud service offering.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST NOT irresponsibly disclose sensitive information in an Ongoing Certification Report that would likely have an adverse effect on the cloud service offering.

changed.name: Next Report Date
changed.text_before: Providers MUST supply the target date for their next Ongoing Certification Report with other public FedRAMP Certification Data.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST supply the target date for their next Ongoing Certification Report with other public FedRAMP Certification Data.

changed.name: Responsible Public Certification Report Sharing
changed.text_before: Providers MAY responsibly supply some or all of the information an Ongoing Certification Report to the public or other parties if the provider determines doing so will NOT likely have an adverse effect on the cloud service offering.
changed.text_after: Providers MAY responsibly supply some or all of the information an Ongoing Certification Report to the public or other parties if the provider determines doing so will NOT likely have an adverse effect on the cloud service offering.

changed.name: Spread Out Reports
changed.text_before: Providers SHOULD establish a regular 3 month cycle for Ongoing Certification Reports that is spread out from the beginning, middle, or end of each quarter.
changed.text_after: Providers SHOULD establish a regular 3 month cycle for Ongoing Certification Reports that is spread out from the beginning, middle, or end of each quarter.

changed.name: Additional Content
changed.text_before: Providers SHOULD supply additional information in Quarterly Reviews that the provider determines is of interest, use, or otherwise relevant to agencies.
changed.text_after: Providers SHOULD supply additional information in Quarterly Reviews that the provider determines is of interest, use, or otherwise relevant to agencies.

changed.name: Next Review Date
changed.text_before: Providers MUST publicly supply the target date for their next Quarterly Review with other public FedRAMP Certification Data.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST publicly supply the target date for their next Quarterly Review with other public FedRAMP Certification Data.

changed.name: Meeting Registration Info
changed.text_before: Providers MUST supply either a registration link or a downloadable calendar file with meeting information for Quarterly Reviews to all necessary parties.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST supply either a registration link or a downloadable calendar file with meeting information for Quarterly Reviews to all necessary parties.

changed.name: Restrict Third Parties
changed.text_before: Providers SHOULD NOT invite third parties to attend Quarterly Reviews intended for agencies unless they have specific relevance.
changed.text_after: Providers SHOULD NOT invite third parties to attend Quarterly Reviews intended for agencies unless they have specific relevance.

changed.name: Record/Transcribe Reviews
changed.text_before: Providers SHOULD record or transcribe Quarterly Reviews and supply them to all necessary parties.
changed.text_after: Providers SHOULD record or transcribe Quarterly Reviews and supply them to all necessary parties.

changed.name: Schedule Around Reports
changed.text_before: Providers SHOULD regularly schedule Quarterly Reviews to occur at least 3 business days after releasing an Ongoing Certification Report AND within 10 business days of such release.
changed.text_after: Providers SHOULD regularly schedule Quarterly Reviews to occur at least 3 business days after releasing an Ongoing Certification Report AND within 10 business days of such release.

changed.name: Share Content Responsibly
changed.text_before: Providers MAY responsibly supply content prepared for a Quarterly Review to the public or other parties if the provider determines doing so will NOT likely have an adverse effect on the cloud service offering.
changed.text_after: Providers MAY responsibly supply content prepared for a Quarterly Review to the public or other parties if the provider determines doing so will NOT likely have an adverse effect on the cloud service offering.

changed.name: Share Recordings Responsibly
changed.text_before: Providers MAY responsibly supply recordings or transcriptions of Quarterly Reviews to the public or other parties ONLY if the provider removes all agency information (comments, questions, names, etc.) AND determines doing so will NOT likely have an adverse effect on the cloud service offering.
changed.text_after: Providers MAY responsibly supply recordings or transcriptions of Quarterly Reviews to the public or other parties ONLY if the provider removes all agency information (comments, questions, names, etc.) AND determines doing so will NOT likely have an adverse effect on the cloud service offering.

changed.text_before: Providers MUST notify all necessary parties when migrating to a trust center and MUST provide information in their existing USDA Connect Community Portal secure folders explaining how to use the trust center to obtain FedRAMP Certification Data.

changed.text_after: Providers MUST treat problems or failures with their vulnerability detection and response processes as vulnerabilities.

changed.name: Maintain Security

changed.text_after: Providers SHOULD NOT weaken the security of information resources to facilitate vulnerability scanning, detection, or assessment activities.

changed.name: Vulnerability Response
changed.text_before: Providers MUST systematically, persistently, and promptly track, evaluate, monitor, mitigate, remediate, assess exploitation of, report, and otherwise manage all detected vulnerabilities within their cloud service offering; this process is called vulnerability response.
changed.text_after: Providers MUST systematically, persistently, and promptly track, evaluate, monitor, mitigate, remediate, assess exploitation of, report, and otherwise manage all detected vulnerabilities within their cloud service offering; this process is called vulnerability response.
